setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays one trig on step 1: root C (MIDI 60, C3) at velocity 50, held for 4 steps. Only Chd1 (E, 64) and Chd4 (C, 72) are set, so Chd2 and Chd3 are empty slots; the output is polyphonic. Chord Note Strum is 1/2, Chord Pattern is <- (reverse: slot 4, 3, 2, 1, then the root), Mute Chord Root is assigned and left at X, and Chord Velocity Mod is +10. Trig params is open on its parameter list, showing Chord Spread; Spread and Chord Accel Mod are not assigned yet.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Spread and K2 to return, then turn E3 up to 1/4. Each gap is now 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4 step. Acceleration works on Spread, so with Spread at zero it would do nothing. Turn E2 to the next slot, press K2 and turn E3 to Chord Accel Mod.
steps.title: Set a quarter-step Spread

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Accel Mod and K2 to return, then turn E3 one detent down to -1: each gap is a quarter step (Spread x 1) shorter than the one before. Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. The gaps are 3/4, 1/2 and 1/4 step, and the gap after that would be 0, so scheduling stops. Slot 4 (C4, 72) sounds at once, empty slots 3 and 2 pass in silence at 3/4 and 1 1/4 steps, and slot 1 (E3, 64) sounds 1 1/2 steps after the trigger. The MIDI strip lists only those two notes; the root C3 (60) never sounds.
